title: Thanksgiving meal in Florida leads to mass food poisoning incident
summary:
Local media reported that 18 people fell ill after attending a Thanksgiving lunch at a medical center headquarters

A Thanksgiving meal in Florida triggered a bout of food poisoning so bad…

blocks.text: A Thanksgiving meal in Florida triggered a bout of food poisoning so bad that local emergency officials said it was a “mass casualty” event as numerous stricken diners were sent to hospital.
Local media reported that 18 people at the Leon medical center headquarters in Doral fell ill due to possible food poisoning after attending the center’s annual Thanksgiving lunch on Wednesday.

Miami-Dade fire rescue crews who received reports of the possible food poisoning said the call was upgraded to a “mass casualty incident” after 15 of those who fell ill required hospitalization, the Miami Herald reported.
In a statement to NBC Miami Leon medical center said: “Some of the staff began to experience gastrointestinal symptoms shortly after the luncheon and required treatment.
“We continue to work with the caterers to determine, if possible, the cause and continue to provide support to our staff and their families.”
No patients at the center were affected. Investigations are continuing as to the exact cause and nature of the food poisoning.
